purpose: the view a ringside ticket actually buys at Bangla Boxing Stadium, looking up at two fighters mid-round from below the canvas

style.look: travel editorial reportage, available light, unposed
style.color_palette: canvas blue and red ropes, warm stage light on skin, deep shadow in the stands
style.texture: fine grain, sweat sheen on skin, matte canvas

location.place: the ringside seats of an open-sided Muay Thai stadium hall
location.weather: warm and humid, the air still
locale_details: the ring ropes are wrapped in red and blue sleeves, the Thai stadium convention
both fighters wear Muay Thai shorts and prajioud armbands, with rope anklets
the canvas carries painted Thai sponsor lettering, worn at the corners
the stand seating is plain moulded plastic bolted to a steel frame

reference.address: Bangla Road behind Jungceylon, Patong, Kathu District, Phuket 83150

sources.shows: the hall layout: a two-storey stadium with bars on the ground floor and an upper amphitheatre of seating wrapped around the ring
the seating tiers: ringside sits below the level of the ring so spectators look up at the fighters, while the stadium seats are raised for a view of the whole ring
the nightly programme: male and female bouts with the Wai Kru Ram Muay performed before each fight

verified_facts: ringside seating sits below the level of the ring, so a spectator there looks up at the fighters
the stadium seats behind ringside are raised, high enough to see the whole ring
the ring stands on a raised platform inside a hall that is open at the sides
bouts run at night, with male and female fighters on the same card
conflicting_claims: sources disagree on the fight nights and the ticket price, so neither appears in this image

subjects.description: Thai Muay Thai fighter in the red corner
subjects.appearance: early twenties, lean and muscular, short black hair, warm brown skin, sweating
subjects.wardrobe: red Muay Thai shorts with gold trim, red prajioud armbands, rope anklets, boxing gloves
subjects.pose: mid-round, weight on the back foot, left arm raised in guard, right knee driving upward
subjects.hands: both hands are inside laced boxing gloves held high at cheek height, thumbs wrapped
subjects.gaze: fixed on the blue-corner fighter in front of him
subjects.expression: concentrated, mouth closed around a gumshield
subjects.action: drives a knee toward the blue-corner fighter
subjects.position: left of centre, inside the ropes

subjects.description: Thai Muay Thai fighter in the blue corner
subjects.appearance: early twenties, lean, short black hair, warm brown skin, sweating
subjects.wardrobe: blue Muay Thai shorts, blue prajioud armbands, rope anklets, boxing gloves
subjects.pose: turning away from the knee, elbows dropped to block, hips twisting right
subjects.hands: both hands are inside laced boxing gloves, forearms turned inward to cover the ribs
subjects.action: turns his hip to take the knee on the forearm
subjects.position: right of centre, inside the ropes, half a step back

objects.name: boxing ring on a raised platform with red and blue rope sleeves
objects.material: steel frame, painted plywood apron, canvas, foam-sleeved rope
objects.size: 6.1 m square canvas, the platform 1.1 m above the floor
objects.scale_anchor: its apron edge meets a standing spectator at the waist, and the fighters' feet start above a seated spectator's head
objects.position: fills the frame from the lower edge upward, the near rope crossing the lower third

objects.name: raised tier of moulded plastic stadium seating
objects.material: moulded plastic seats on a galvanised steel frame
objects.state: filled with spectators, faces lost in the dark
objects.size: about 4 m high at the back row
objects.scale_anchor: its back row sits well above the ring canvas, about twice a standing person's height off the floor
objects.position: behind and above the ring, filling the upper background

spatial_layout.foreground: the near rope and the canvas edge, close and slightly soft
spatial_layout.midground: the two fighters on the canvas, sharp
spatial_layout.background: the raised seating tier and the dark open side of the hall, soft

key.source: a bank of hard stage floodlights rigged directly above the ring
key.quality: hard, from small sources high overhead, so shadows are short and dense

fill: spill from the stadium house lights lifting the canvas
bounce off the pale canvas under the fighters' chins

composition.subject_placement: the two fighters on the left and right thirds with the point of contact on the centre line, the near rope crossing the lower third
composition.negative_space: the upper right quarter, where the dark open side of the hall reads as an even black field
composition.crop_safety: both fighters and the point of contact stay inside a centre square, so a 1:1 crop loses only the stand

imperfections: the canvas is scuffed grey along the near rope where feet drag
one rope sleeve has slipped, showing the bare rope beneath it at the left post
sweat has darkened the waistband of the red fighter's shorts

physical_invariants: the camera is a ringside seat below the canvas, so the whole ring is seen from underneath and the near rope cuts across the fighters' legs
the fighters stand 1.1 m above the camera's floor, so the eye-level line passes below their feet
the floodlights hang directly above the ring, so each fighter's shadow pools on the canvas beneath him rather than stretching sideways
the knee and the forearm meet at one point, and both bodies lean consistently with that contact
the seating tier behind rises away from the ring, so its rows recede to the same vanishing point as the ring ropes
must_not_show: readable sponsor names, promoter logos or ticket prices
western boxing gloves without rope anklets or prajioud armbands
a referee standing between the fighters
